The consumer must recompute the source projection digest and bind continuity into the policy, intent binding, state, loop identity, and fresh-resume digest.

A producer all-complete selection handoff is contradictory under the current selection-handoff schema, so the producer must fail closed while the consumer can still prove FRONTIER_COMPLETE from a valid direct continuity projection.
Historical semantic drift cannot be safely synthesized; only an explicit all-pending fallback may be compiled before a fresh passing audit.
